summary: Headless FontLoader component that renders null. On first render (run-once hook from module 9995) it reads the font map from useI18n().font and, for every [family, source] entry, creates a FontFace(family, source), adds it to document.fonts and awaits load(). If loading fails the FontFace is removed and it retries with only the comma-separated source part containing '.woff2' (falling back to the full source string); any remaining error is logged with console.error.
